objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and displayed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Default name includes document type abbreviation, consecutive 4-digit number per type, and title.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document workflow or lifecycle status, including editing, released, and out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity count starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version used before translation is released.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document object and used for templates, validity periods, archive duration, and structuring documents.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation included in document names by default.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be checked for the document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents of the document type are kept before physical deletion.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created for editing, release, revision, invalidation, or reactivation.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status metadata that can be printed in the document.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific metadata maintained in document properties and grouped into categories.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose in document properties.

objs.name: attribute
objs.description: Maintainable metadata field in document properties used for references, IT applications, relevant companies, areas of validity, participants, authorizations, and distribution.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using DHC VISION who can create, edit, review, release, translate, acknowledge, or receive notifications depending on assignments and rights.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for reader assignment, authorization, distribution, archive access, and role-specific selection lists.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to user groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement workflows.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Email used to inform involved users of workflow tasks, document release, validity extension, override, change proposals, and acknowledgement requests.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the main document release cycle and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a main document and automatically released, archived, or reactivated with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing a document created and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning user groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement of a document version by persons on the distribution list.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific dashboard listing documents relevant to users based on distribution groups.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data, such as IT applications, with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained in document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

evts.name: upload_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata in property editing.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print certain metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current document version on the web or in a dashboard.

evts.name: change_document
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content or properties.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, or translation participants in document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an attachment to a document by attaching a new information object.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so that it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, maintenance, and control definition.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves release so the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid released document is revised or specified changes occur.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, keep the current version valid, and update valid until.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected released document.

evts.name: process_request_for_override
evts.description: Process the override request with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document and attachments invalid, archive them, and revoke rights except for the archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Process the reactivation request with workflow support.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document, restore maintained properties, authorizations, distribution list, and archived attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain a distribution list for a document by assigning user groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request persons and users of assigned user groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Use a report or search with selection parameters and criteria to evaluate documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition or extension and reference the original document.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatically link documents in the system with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, or master data.

o2o.description: Document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created using a selected template.
A document has versions managed through editing, release, revision, invalidation, and reactivation.
Document properties contain standardized and customer-specific metadata.
Metadata and attributes are grouped in categories according to purpose.
Maintainable attributes are part of document metadata.

Document properties include attributes such as references, IT applications, relevant companies, areas of validity, reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translation, and distribution attributes.
Persons can be assigned to a document as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, distribution recipient, or workflow participant.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, roles, distribution, and archive access.
Authorizations are assigned for each document.
Users can be assigned to user groups.
Users receive read or write permissions when assigned in relevant document attributes.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users for each document.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version.
Additional information can be added to each document and is associated with the main document.
Attachments are associated with a main document and released, archived, and reactivated with it.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for override is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to a distribution list.
Acknowledgement concerns the current released document version.
Recipients confirm acknowledgement.
Dashboards list documents relevant to the user based on distribution assignments.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Documents can be linked with processes.
Documents can be linked with organizational units.
Documents can be linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with master data.
References are maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.
Documents can reference other documents, including a local document referencing an original document.
